ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 4:1 ratio of low-intensity (black) to high-intensity (white) pixels; high-intensity pixels are predominantly localized at the distal lateral tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white geometric blob at the left distal tip; larger, fragmented white patch at the right distal tip containing high-density black linear interruptions; central and lower regions comprise a solid low-intensity black mass.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Narrow V-shaped depression with a vertex angle of approximately 45 degrees; notch depth extends approximately 12% into the vertical height of the fluke lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency jagged serrations along the entire boundary; variations show amplitudes of 3 to 15 pixels; distinct irregular notches present on the lateral outer edges.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: S-shaped curve characterized by a convex sweep from the median notch transitioning into a concave taper toward the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular and elliptical high-contrast white pixel clusters (5-12 pixel diameter) scattered across the black ventral surface, concentrated in the lower-left and lower-right quadrants.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of multi-directional, unaligned linear white pixel disruptions (rake marks) spanning the majority of both lobes, including a cluster of parallel vertical marks on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pervasive linear rake marks across the ventral surface and significant jagged irregular indentations/notches along the trailing edge boundary consistent with physical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive set of five parallel vertical linear scars on the upper portion of the right fluke lobe.
